name: Micro Expresión V2
description: Detecta micro expresiones anómalas en video para identificar deepfakes
algorithm: Micro-Expression v2 — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method detects and analyzes micro-expressions for deepfake detection:

1. **Micro - Expression Detección**: Micro-expressions are brief (40-200ms), involuntary facial expressions that reveal suppressed emotions. The method detects these by analyzing high-temporal-resolution facial AU changes — rapid onset-apex-offset cycles that are shorter than voluntary expressions.

2. **Temporal Characteristics Verificación**: Genuine micro-expressions have specific temporal properties: (a) duration 40-200ms (much shorter than regular expressions at 0.5-4s), (b) rapid onset (<60ms), (c) may show asymmetry or incomplete expression. The method verifies that detected micro-expressions conform to these established psychological criteria.

3. **Presence/Absence Análisis**: Natural human behavior includes occasional micro-expressions during emotional suppression or deception. Their complete absence from a video where emotional context suggests suppression is suspicious. Conversely, AI-generated faces rarely produce micro-expressions as they are not explicitly modeled by most generators.

4. **Micro - Expression Authenticity**: Detected candidate micro-expressions are evaluated for authenticity: genuine micro-expressions involve specific AU combinations consistent with basic emotions, show physiologically constrained dynamics, and typically appear during emotionally charged moments. Fabricated micro-movements without these characteristics may indicate generation artifacts.

5. **Micro - Expression - Context Coherencia**: The emotional content of micro-expressions should be contextually plausible — a micro-expression of fear during casual conversation is suspicious. The method evaluates whether micro-expression content is contextually appropriate, using behavioral science criteria for naturalness assessment.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante micro-expression v2 analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
